candidate_anchor.primary: open-play Type=PASS with nonmissing To, valid End Frame/End Time used as reception anchor, and valid tracked ball at anchor; Metrica has no separate completion flag, so these fields operationalize completed reception
candidate_anchor.primary_overlap_rule: retain earliest eligible anchor; suppress later anchors whose [-2,+3] windows overlap; resume after retained window end
candidate_anchor.sensitivity_overlap_rule: rebuild independently for [-3,+5] and apply earliest-first eight-second overlap suppression
sensitivities: possession change at event Start Time/Start Frame of the first possession-bearing event whose Team differs from the previous possession-bearing event in the same period; qualifying Types are PASS, RECOVERY, SET PIECE, and SHOT; exclude restarts; event Team is possession team; same windows, exclusions, spacing, focal ball-nearest rule, controls, matching, outputs, and statistics

restarts.source: literal Type/Subtype vocabulary in Sample Game 1 event log

possession.pseudo_anchor: Team from most recent event at or before anchor whose Type is PASS, RECOVERY, SET PIECE, or SHOT; carry forward within period until next such event; never infer from ball proximity

pseudo_anchor_grid.grid: integer elapsed-match seconds represented by the nearest exact 25 Hz tracking frame
pseudo_anchor_grid.control_overlap: after matching, remove all pseudo-anchors whose window overlaps selected control; controls cannot overlap candidates or other selected controls
pseudo_anchor_grid.sensitivity: reconstruct grid eligibility and overlap exclusions using eight-second window

matching.candidate_order: chronological; earlier retained candidates receive first access

support_failure.action_below: declare primary design poorly supported; do not loosen; continue descriptive and frozen sensitivities only

references.focal_primary: outfield defender nearest tracked ball at anchor for both candidates and controls; exclude if anchor ball missing

local.selection: at window start, focal plus nearest and second-nearest eligible outfield teammates

opponents.selection: at window start, nearest and second-nearest opponents to focal

ordering_reversal.definition: compare signs of all three pairwise coordinate differences at window start and end; indicator=1 if any non-tied pair reverses sign

core_complete_case: at least two valid outfield teammates at start
at least two valid opponents at start
complete defending-outfield coordinates required for leave-one-out centroid throughout window
missing_data.ball_family: family-specific complete case: both matched windows require complete ball coordinates throughout

directional_coherence.definition: mean-vector magnitude of normalized individual defending-outfield net-displacement vectors across window

generic_activity.primary: sum of physical path lengths of all available defending outfield players across fixed window

effect_sizes: standardized paired mean difference dz = mean(d)/sd(d); undefined if sd(d)=0

bootstrap.child_seeds: deterministically derived from base seed and section name

continuous_test.null: paired differences symmetrically centered at zero
continuous_test.method: two-sided exact sign-flip when computationally practical; otherwise 100000 Monte Carlo sign flips

statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each of six descriptor families only; no descriptor dropped; p-values secondary

negative_control.selection: uniform random among valid shifted anchors using deterministic child seed from 20260828 and candidate anchor identity
negative_control.if_none: candidate contributes no negative-control pair; do not broaden
negative_control.sensitivity: recompute valid shifts using eight-second window and overlap rules

interpretation.A: stable interpretable typed differences remain after matching and are not reproduced by generic activity or negative controls
interpretation.B: some typed differences remain but are overlapping, event-dependent, reference-sensitive, or context-heavy
interpretation.C: differences are absent, vanish under reasonable matching, or are reproduced by generic activity or negative controls

permitted_geometry: anchor ball location for focal selection and coarse ball-zone matching
window-start geometry for fixed local/opponent identities
